item.caption:
🚨 Are YOU registered to vote, New Hampshire? Election Day is THIS Tuesday, November 3! 🗳️ 

Now is the time to double-check your voter registration status and make sure you have everything you need to vote!

✅ Double-check your voter registration status, find your polling place, and view a sample ballot at app.sos.nh.gov/voterinformation

Not registered yet? No worries! New Hampshire allows eligible voters to register right at the polls on Election Day! 📄 Make sure you gather the documents you need to prove your Age, Citizenship, Identity, and Domicile (where you live)—remember “ACID!” You can bring documents in paper or electronic form, including photos! 📷

Don't have documentary proof of citizenship handy? You can still register! Eligible voters may sign a Qualified Voter Affidavit (QVA) to attest to their citizenship, subject to the penalties for voter fraud.

✅ Get more information on New Hampshire elections at sos.nh.gov/elections

📣 We challenge YOU to tag ONE FRIEND in the comments and remind them to check their registration or get their documents ready for November 3! A little preparation now can make all the difference on Election Day! 📣 

#OpenDemocracyNH #NewHampshire #NHVotes #VotingRights #Vote #ElectionDay #NH

⏳Final Friday before the Election!🗳

We are pleased to support George Bell for the NC Court of Appeals (Seat 2)🇺🇸

🔔Are you ready to ring the BELL for justice?🔔

Judge George Bell has over 20 years of experience with the law in North Carolina and has been a Supreme Court Judge for Mecklenburg County since 2019. As you can imagine, the civil and criminal cases that he's had before him have provided Judge Bell with a sobering picture of the crimes that we as North Carolinians deal with in our state.

When asked about his approach as a judge, he said: "I follow the rule of law and administer justice impartially, without prejudice or bias. I believe that people need to be held accountable for their actions." He is committed to justice and common sense while following the Constitution to keep North Carolina families safe.

Judge Bell has been called the conservative, constitutional, common sense candidate for this seat. If you look through his work, you'll see why.

You only have 2 more chances to vote for him!
-Early Voting is Saturday, October 31st 8AM-3PM
-Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd 6:30AM-7:30PM

author: chat_with_courtney

item.authorHandle: chat_with_courtney
item.caption:
🇺🇸 Have you voted yet?

We are just FOUR days away from the 2026 midterm elections, and I've been keeping an eye on the numbers!

Here's something I found interesting!

During the 2022 midterm elections, approximately 45.9 million Americans voted early.

As of October 30, 2026, more than 46 MILLION Americans have already cast their ballots!

We've already surpassed the 2022 early voting numbers, and Election Day isn't even here yet!

Now, these numbers don't tell us who is winning, but they certainly show how many Americans are participating in this election.

But here's something I've been thinking about.

Who you are for is more important than what you are against.

It's so easy to get caught up in the arguments, disagreements, and everything happening in politics. And goodness, there is plenty of it! 😂

But voting is a constitutional right, and this should not be taken lightly.

The decisions being made today affect our families, our communities, and future generations. We have an opportunity to make our voices heard, and I believe that comes with a responsibility to be informed.

Not voting is simply not an option we can afford to choose.

We don't have to agree on every issue or candidate to treat one another with kindness and respect.

God is still on the throne and we do not live in the spirit of fear.

"For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind." — 2 Timothy 1:7 (KJV)

We can care deeply about the direction of our country without allowing fear, anger, or division to consume us.

Be informed. Ask questions. Do your research. Understand what you're voting for, not just what you're voting against.

And remember, how we treat people matters long after the election is over.

🇺🇸 Election Day is Tuesday, November 3rd!

Have you already cast your ballot, or are you planning to vote Tuesday?

#MidtermElections2026 #ElectionDay #FaithOverFear

item.caption:
🗳️ Your voice matters. Your vote matters. Our climate future matters. 🌎

With #ElectionDay approaching on November 3, we encourage everyone to make a plan to vote and participate in shaping the future of our communities.

At Hammond Climate Solutions Foundation, we’re working to expedite positive change for a just and livable future. We know that decisions made at every level of government can influence clean energy, environmental justice, climate resilience and the health of our communities.

We encourage voters to learn about the candidates and ballot measures, consider how different policies could affect the issues that matter to them and make informed decisions.

✅ Check your voter registration status, find your polling place and access election information: www.vote.gov. 

🗳️ Vote early if you can! Many states offer early in-person voting or voting by mail, allowing you to cast your ballot before Election Day. Check your state’s options and deadlines so you can make a plan that works for you.

🌎 Your vote is your voice. Make it count!
